title: Should I Stick with Wired or Try Wireless Gaming Headsets?
summary: Debating between wired gaming headsets and wireless gaming headsets? Explore the pros and cons of wired vs wireless Turtle Beach headsets to help you ch...
body_text: The eternal gaming debate: wired vs wireless headsets . You're in the middle of an intense match when your wireless headset dies, or your wired cable snags and yanks you back to reality. Both scenarios are frustrating, but which connection type truly serves gamers better in 2025? Modern wireless gaming headsets have evolved dramatically, with some models now offering battery life exceeding 70 hours and latency as low as 10ms in specialized low-latency modes. Meanwhile, wired gaming headsets continue to dominate competitive gaming with their minimal processing delays and unlimited playtime. The choice between these two isn't just about convenience; it's about matching your gaming style to the right technology. Whether you're a competitive esports player demanding millisecond precision or a casual gamer who values freedom of movement, understanding the real-world differences between wired and wireless options helps you make the right choice for your setup. Advantages of Wired Headsets – Latency, Reliability, and Sound Quality Minimal Processing Latency Wired gaming headsets deliver unmatched responsiveness for competitive gaming. The latency advantage comes from reduced signal processing requirements; wired connections bypass the encoding, transmission, and decoding steps required for wireless audio. This processing difference, rather than fundamental transmission speed, provides essentially zero additional latency compared to wireless alternatives. Gaming headset latency issues become critical in fast-paced games like first-person shooters or rhythm games. Even premium wireless gaming headsets with specialized low-latency modes achieve around 10ms latency under optimal conditions , while wired connections offer near-instantaneous audio transmission without requiring special modes. Uninterrupted Gaming Sessions Wired headset sound quality remains consistent without battery concerns. Unlike wireless models that may experience performance degradation as batteries drain, wired headsets deliver consistent audio output throughout extended gaming sessions. You'll never face the frustration of dead batteries during crucial moments. For competitive gaming setups, wired connections also eliminate potential wireless interference from other 2.4GHz devices, ensuring stable audio transmission regardless of your environment's RF noise levels. Broad Platform Compatibility Wired vs wireless headsets differ significantly in platform compatibility. Most wired models with 3.5mm connections work across PC , consoles, and many mobile devices, though some modern devices may require adapters due to varying port configurations or the removal of headphone jacks entirely. The Turtle Beach headset collection includes several wired models that demonstrate this broad compatibility approach , offering consistent performance whether connected to a PC, Xbox, PlayStation, or Nintendo Switch through appropriate connections. Advantages of Wireless Headsets – Mobility, Convenience, and Modern Features Freedom of Movement Wireless gaming headsets transform your gaming experience by eliminating cable management concerns. Whether you're grabbing a drink during loading screens or adjusting your seating position, wireless models provide unrestricted movement within your gaming area. This freedom becomes especially valuable for VR gaming, console gaming from a couch, or any setup where cable length limitations might restrict your positioning. Wireless headsets let you game comfortably from optimal distances without being tethered to your device. Extended Battery Life Revolution Modern wireless headset battery life has reached impressive levels. Premium wireless gaming headsets now offer 20-40 hours of continuous use, with exceptional models reaching 60+ hours on a single charge. This battery performance eliminates frequent charging concerns for most users, though actual battery life varies based on volume levels and usage patterns. Fast-charging technology further enhances convenience. Many wireless headsets can provide 6-9 hours of use from just 15 minutes of charging , making even emergency charging scenarios manageable. Advanced Connectivity Features Best gaming headsets 2025 increasingly offer dual connectivity options. Premium wireless models provide both 2.4GHz low-latency connections for gaming and Bluetooth for mobile devices, enabling seamless switching between gaming and communication needs. These connectivity options allow simultaneous connections to multiple devices, letting you play on PC while remaining connected to your phone for calls or notifications, a functionality that is impossible with traditional wired headsets. Key Considerations – Battery Life, Compatibility, and Use Cases Platform-Specific Performance Gaming headsets for PC/console scenarios require different considerations. PC gaming typically offers more flexibility, supporting both high-end wired and wireless options through multiple USB ports and audio outputs. Console gaming may favor wireless solutions to avoid controller port limitations and cable management issues. For specialized gaming setups, consider how your choice integrates with other peripherals. Gaming controllers and gaming keyboards may influence your headset decision based on available ports and desk space management. Battery Management Strategies Wireless headset battery life requires proactive management. Most wireless gaming headsets offer 20-40 hours of battery life under typical conditions , with exceptional models reaching 60+ hours. Understanding your usage patterns helps determine whether wireless battery life meets your needs. Consider your typical gaming session length and charging habits. If you game for 4-6 hours daily, a headset with 40+ hour battery life provides nearly a week of use per charge cycle, making battery management relatively painless. Audio Quality Considerations Wired vs wireless audio lag isn't the only technical difference. Wireless transmission involves signal processing that can minimally affect frequency response compared to wired connections, though modern 2.4GHz wireless systems deliver performance very close to wired transmission for gaming applications. For audiophile-level listening, wired connections maintain a slight technical advantage. However, for gaming purposes, high-quality wireless headsets provide negligible practical differences in audio fidelity for most users. Use Cases – Competitive Gaming, Casual Play, and Streaming Competitive Gaming Priorities Are wired headsets better for gaming in competitive scenarios? The answer depends on your competitive level and game type. Professional and hardcore gamers typically prefer wired headsets to eliminate any possibility of latency affecting performance. For esports and ranked competitive play, wired headsets remain the gold standard. The combination of minimal processing latency, unlimited playtime, and consistent performance aligns with competitive gaming's demands for reliability and precision. Casual Gaming Flexibility Casual gamers often benefit more from wireless convenience. If you prioritize comfort, movement freedom, and multi-device connectivity over absolute minimum latency, wireless headsets enhance your overall gaming experience significantly. Wireless gaming headsets excel for casual gaming scenarios: couch gaming, party games with friends, or any situation where you value convenience over competitive edge. The freedom to move naturally during gaming sessions often outweighs minimal latency considerations. Content Creation Considerations Streamers and content creators should look for unique considerations. Wireless headsets offer presentation advantages, no visible cables in webcam footage, and freedom to move during streams. However, wired headsets ensure uninterrupted audio during long recording sessions without battery concerns. For serious content creation, consider your recording environment and session lengths. Wireless models work excellently for shorter content sessions, while wired headsets better suit marathon streaming sessions or professional recording scenarios. Specialized Gaming Applications For flight simulation and racing enthusiasts, specialized controllers like the Velocity One Flight or racing simulation setups may influence headset choice based on cockpit layouts and cable management needs. Similarly, competitive racing with racing wheels might favor wireless headsets to avoid cable interference with steering wheel rotation and pedal operation. VelocityOne™ Flight Universal Control System View Product Making the Right Choice for Your Gaming Style Budget and Value Considerations Wired vs wireless headsets pricing differs significantly across categories. Wired models generally offer better value at entry and mid-range price points, providing excellent audio quality without wireless technology costs. Wireless headsets typically command premium prices but justify the cost through convenience features. For budget-conscious gamers, wired options like the Recon 70 headset deliver excellent gaming audio without wireless technology expenses. Premium users might prefer wireless models like the Stealth 700 Gen 3 for advanced features and convenience . Future-Proofing Your Setup Gaming technology continues to evolve rapidly. Wireless standards improve regularly, with newer models offering better battery life, lower latency, and enhanced features. Wired technology, while mature, remains consistently reliable without requiring updates or compatibility concerns. Consider your upgrade frequency and technology adoption preferences. Early adopters might prefer wireless models for cutting-edge features, while users preferring long-term stability might choose proven wired solutions. Personal Gaming Environment Your physical gaming setup influences the optimal choice significantly. Desk gaming with limited space might favor wired headsets for simpler cable management, while living room gaming setups typically benefit from wireless freedom. Wireless gaming headsets particularly excel in multi-purpose rooms where you might need to step away briefly while maintaining voice chat connectivity with teammates. Which option fits your style? The wired vs wireless gaming headsets decision ultimately depends on your gaming priorities and setup requirements. Competitive gamers demanding an absolute minimum latency and unlimited playtime should choose wired headsets for their reliability and minimal processing delays. Casual gamers valuing convenience, movement freedom, and modern connectivity features will find wireless headsets transformative for their gaming experience. Modern wireless gaming headsets have largely eliminated traditional concerns about battery life and latency for most gaming scenarios. With 40-70 hour battery life and sub-20ms latency becoming standard in gaming-grade wireless models, wireless technology now offers compelling advantages for many users. For specialized gaming needs, products like the Atlas Air headset demonstrate how wired technology can enhance specific gaming experiences , while traditional wired options like the Airlite Fit continue to excel in their reliability and value propositions . Consider your typical gaming sessions, competitive level, and setup requirements. Both wired and wireless headsets have earned their place in modern gaming. Choose the option that best matches your gaming style and priorities. FAQ Are wired headsets better for gaming? Wired headsets offer minimal processing latency and unlimited playtime, making them superior for competitive gaming where millisecond advantages matter. For casual gaming, wireless headsets often provide better overall convenience despite minimal latency trade-offs. Do wireless gaming headsets have lag? Modern wireless gaming headsets using 2.4GHz connections typically have 10-25ms latency, barely perceptible for most gaming. Bluetooth connections have higher latency (70ms+) and aren't recommended for gaming. Quality 2.4GHz wireless headsets perform nearly as well as wired ones for most gaming scenarios. Which lasts longer, wired or wireless headsets? Wired headsets physically last longer since they lack batteries that degrade over time. However, modern wireless headsets offer 40-300 hours of battery life and maintain performance for several years with proper care. Wired headsets provide unlimited playtime but may suffer cable wear over time. Is sound quality better on wired or wireless headsets? Wired connections technically offer slightly better frequency response and zero signal compression. However, high-quality wireless headsets using 2.4GHz connections deliver audio quality that's practically indistinguishable from wired for gaming purposes. The difference is rarely noticeable outside of audiophile-level listening. Are wireless headsets worth it for competitive gaming? For casual competitive gaming, modern low-latency wireless headsets perform adequately. However, professional esports players and serious competitive gamers typically prefer wired headsets to eliminate any possibility of latency or battery issues affecting performance during crucial moments.

title: Driving Forward: AmpUp Joins the EPRI Vetted Product List
summary: AmpUp is now officially on the Electric Power Research Institute (EPRI) Vetted Product List, the gold standard for EV charging solutions.
body_text: TL;DR: Big news! AmpUp is now officially on the Electric Power Research Institute (EPRI) Vetted Product List, the gold standard for EV charging solutions.This recognition means easier access to incentives, faster deployments, and reliable, grid-ready charging. Get your next project moving — connect with AmpUp today! _____ ‍ We are thrilled to announce that AmpUp has been included on the prestigious Electric Power Research Institute (EPRI) Vetted Product List (VPL). This achievement is a testament to the reliability, functionality, and utility-readiness of the AmpUp platform , marking a key step forward in our mission to make EV charging simple, reliable, and accessible across North America. Why EPRI's Vetted Product List Matters For those working to expand electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure, the EPRI Vetted Product List is the gold standard. Founded in 1972, EPRI is the world's preeminent independent, non-profit energy research and development organization. Their trusted experts collaborate with over 450 companies in 45 countries, driving innovation to ensure the public has access to clean, safe, reliable, and affordable electricity. EPRI’s VPL is a comprehensive, consolidated resource for utilities, state agencies, and industry stakeholders to vet products and equipment for EV charging deployment. Inclusion on this list means a product has been rigorously evaluated against criteria developed through industry consensus, utility input, and government agency requirements. Inclusion on the EPRI VPL is critical because it: Simplifies Utility and Rebate Approval: Many utility and state incentive programs , which provide millions of dollars in funding for EV infrastructure, require products to be EPRI-listed for eligibility. AmpUp's presence on the VPL helps our customers more easily access these vital funds and accelerate their projects. Ensures Reliability and Quality: The rigorous vetting process verifies that the product meets the highest standards for performance, interoperability, and long-term sustainability. Streamlines Deployment: By using a pre-vetted solution, charging network owners, fleets, and municipalities can save significant time and resources that would otherwise be spent navigating complex and often slow individual utility approval processes. AmpUp: Meeting the Demand for a Modern Grid AmpUp's addition to the VPL is a recognition of our commitment to delivering a charging management solution that benefits not only the station owner and the EV driver , but also the electric grid itself. Our platform is designed to be fully featured and utility-ready, offering capabilities like advanced load management and seamless integration for demand response programs. These features are essential for utilities as they work to modernize the grid and efficiently manage the growing energy demands of widespread EV adoption. Being EPRI-vetted means that utilities and partners can have absolute confidence in our platform's ability to: Integrate Seamlessly: Our open, OCPP-compliant software supports a wide range of hardware, allowing for flexible and future-proof network expansion. Ensure Driver Satisfaction: With industry-leading uptime and a user-friendly experience, we help drive high utilization rates. Support Grid Stability: Our intelligent energy management tools enable site hosts to optimize charging, reduce peak demand charges, and participate in utility programs that support grid resilience. A Reliable Future, Powered by AmpUp The future of transportation is electric, and building a reliable, interconnected charging ecosystem is paramount. By earning a place on the EPRI Vetted Product List, AmpUp has solidified its position as a trusted, high-quality partner for entities committed to the clean energy transition. Whether you’re planning a small pilot or deploying across an entire portfolio, AmpUp can help you design a charging program that fits your property, budget, and operational needs. Request a demo , email info@ampup.io , or call (833) 692-6787 . ‍

title: Bring your own AI model & GitLab export & new admin powers
summary: See the latest product updates and improvements to Deepnote.
body_text: October 23, 2025 Bring your own AI model & GitLab export & new admin powers Bring your own AI model Enterprise workspaces can now connect their own OpenAI-compatible endpoints to power Deepnote Agent - giving you full control over the AI provider behind your data analysis workflows. This is especially valuable for organizations that need to: Meet compliance or regional data requirements with specific AI providers Leverage proprietary or fine-tuned models optimized for specific use cases Keep data within specific infrastructure boundaries Setting it up is straightforward: Head to Settings & Members → AI tab and click Add model Provide your endpoint URL, model ID, and API key Set it as your workspace default, and Agent will use your custom model for all analysis tasks Learn more about custom AI models Export notebooks to GitLab Great news for GitLab users - you can now export your notebooks directly to GitLab repositories , just like you've been able to with GitHub. Whether you need to back up your work, maintain audit trails for compliance, or trigger automated pipelines, exporting to GitLab is now just a few clicks away: Open any project, click the Version history icon in the top right, then select Connect Git repository and choose GitLab (you'll connect your GitLab account if you haven't already) Pick your repository, specify the target branch and path, and choose whether to include outputs Export manually with the Commit & push button, or set up automatic exports whenever you create a new version Check out the docs to get started with GitLab exports. New admin powers We've shipped a suite of new workspace settings that give admins more control over security and permissions - perfect for enterprise teams with strict governance requirements. Restrict email invites to your domain : Admins can now limit workspace and project invites to only email addresses matching the workspace owner's domain, preventing accidental external invites Disable incoming connections workspace-wide : Turn off the ability for project editors to enable incoming connections, giving admins full control over external access points Control private project creation : Disable the creation of new private projects in your workspace while keeping existing ones intact Set default permissions for public projects : Choose what permissions workspace members get on newly created public projects - from Full access down to View only These controls give you the flexibility to create the right permission environment suited to your organization's specific security and collaboration needs.

title: Red River Mutual Enters a New Era of Pricing Agility with PricingCenter
body_text: Home Resources Resources Download Center Guidewire Conversations Podcasts Blog Help and Support Insurance Technology FAQ Blog Blog All Blog Posts Best Practices Careers Customer Viewpoint Developers General Interest Partner Perspective Technology Trends Industry Trends General Interest Red River Mutual Enters a New Era of Pricing Agility with PricingCenter In pricing, time really is money. Every week spent waiting on new data or rebuilding a model is another week of missed opportunity. When I joined Red River Mutual as VP of Data and Analytics in 2021, I wanted to close that gap. We needed a faster, more reliable way to move from data to decision, which became the foundation for rebuilding our pricing approach. Today, with PricingCenter, our team can build, test, and deploy models in a fraction of the time it used to take. But that kind of progress doesn’t happen overnight. It started with setting the right foundation. Building a Pricing Function from the Ground Up When I joined Red River Mutual, there wasn’t a dedicated actuarial team yet, and most of the analytics work lived within IT. The company saw an opportunity to change that by making pricing a strategic focus and investing in the people and tools to support it. I now lead three connected teams (insights and analytics, actuarial pricing, and insurance products), all focused on bringing more precision and speed to every pricing decision. As the company has grown, this structure has become essential. Back in 2017, Red River Mutual had about 60 employees and around $60 million in written premium. By the end of this year, we’ll be close to $300 million with more than 200 employees. As the second-largest writer in Manitoba, we’re competing with some of the biggest insurers in Canada, so we have to stay agile. That’s what led us to start exploring new pricing tools. Something that would help our team move faster without sacrificing accuracy. The search brought us to a product called Quantee, now known as PricingCenter. Cutting Months of Model Work to Days From the start, my goal was to create a pricing foundation that kept the team from rebuilding tools and models from scratch each time. PricingCenter gave us that. It takes care of the basics so our actuaries can focus on analysis, modeling, and pricing strategy. It’s made onboarding easier, too. We brought in a co-op student who was new to the industry, and within just a few weeks, they were working confidently in the system. That kind of accessibility makes a big difference when you’re growing a team and want everyone contributing right away. Another major benefit has been how much faster we can update our models. PricingCenter makes it easy to bring in new data and refresh our work without starting over. When other internal projects paused our implementation for a bit, we were able to pick it back up later, add the latest data, and keep going. That continuity helps us keep momentum, even when priorities shift. PricingCenter has also improved how we move from analysis to execution. Once models are developed, the system connects our actuarial work more closely with our rating engine and policy systems. With the push of a button, we can now move rates and models straight into production, so we can act on new data faster and keep our pricing up to date. It’s a simple change, but it’s made a big difference for our team and how we compete. What’s Next for Pricing at Red River Mutual I’m excited about how PricingCenter continues to evolve within the Guidewire ecosystem. As modeling, product design, and implementation come closer together, it’s going to make moving from idea to market even smoother for teams like ours. I believe nothing but magic can come from it. For Red River Mutual, adopting PricingCenter has strengthened how we price and given our team the foundation to keep growing. This blog is inspired by a conversation between Brian Desmond, CMO of Guidewire, and Amanda Evenson, VP of Data and Analytics at Red River Mutual. Check out the full conversation here . title: Air T, Inc. Enters into Agreement with Regional Express Holdings Limited
summary: Air T, Inc. Enters into Agreement with Regional Express Holdings Limited
body_text: Air T, Inc. Enters into Agreement with Regional Express Holdings Limited by Media Team | Oct 21, 2025 | Press Release MINNEAPOLIS, MN – October 20, 2025 – Air T, Inc. (NASDAQ:AIRT) has entered into a Sale and Implementation Deed ( SID ) with the Administrators of Regional Express Holdings Limited (Administrators Appointed) and certain of its subsidiaries (Rex), which operates the leading regional airline in Australia. Air T expects to close the acquisition of Rex by year-end if creditor and other approvals are obtained. Air T has been working closely with the Administrators and the Australian Government, Rex’s secured lender, to develop a solution that best serves the interests of all stakeholders. To support the implementation of the acquisition, Air T and the Commonwealth of Australia have entered into an agreement pursuant to which Rex’s financing arrangements will be restructured in connection with the acquisition . . The proposed acquisition contemplates a continuation and growth of Rex’s regional airline business and continuing employment for its workforce. Rex plays an essential role in connecting regional Australian communities. Approximately 50% of Rex’s routes are not serviced by any other airline. Air T likes the Rex Saab 340 program and will be funding Rex’s engine renewal program and returning its fleet to service. Air T will work to ensure Rex will continue to operate on a sustainable basis, thereby providing critical services to regional Australians. Air T believes it was selected to acquire the company in part because of its long-term investment horizon, experience in regional aircraft, and commitment to stabilizing and growing Rex. The transaction remains subject to certain other approvals, including approval by Rex’s creditors and the Federal Court of Australia. Further disclosure regarding the implementation of the transaction will be provided as the transaction progresses. Air T remains committed to transparency and will share information about the transaction during this process. About AIR T, INC. Established in 1980, Air T, Inc. is a portfolio of powerful businesses and financial assets, each of which is independent yet interrelated. Its core segments are overnight air cargo, ground support equipment, commercial aircraft, engines and parts, and digital solutions. We seek to expand, strengthen and diversify Air T’s after-tax cash flow per share. Our goal is to build Air T’s core businesses, and when appropriate, to expand into adjacent and other industries. We seek to activate growth and overcome challenges while delivering meaningful value for all stakeholders. For more information, visit www.airt.com .
